LESSON: HADITH ON IMAN

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: HADITH 4.1 Hadith on swalah By the end of the sub-strand the  Learners in group
Topic 4.2: Hadith on Iman

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Hadith on Iman. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Hadith on Iman
2. Practise Hadith on Iman at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Hadith on Iman

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Hadith on Iman
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Hadith on Iman. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Hadith on Iman at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Hadith on Iman at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Hadith on Iman
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Hadith on Iman. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Hadith on Iman using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Hadith on Iman in the examples.
2. Explain Hadith on Iman to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Hadith on Iman.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on Iman using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Hadith on Iman important for a Grade 2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
